primary_risks: CAN bitrate, termination, and node-ID conflicts can look like software faults.
Blocking SDO access must not enter the cyclic control path.
Heartbeat timeout evidence is not a certified safety function.

evidence_required: fault log from heartbeat or bus dropout test
primary_risks: Wrong PDO mapping can make statusword or position feedback misleading.
EtherCAT interface selection and permissions can fail before the controller code is reached.
Physical cable-pull tests must be low energy and must not be used as certified safety evidence.
Simulation can validate software behavior but cannot validate electrical wiring, real drive timing, encoder scaling, or physical stop paths.
